title: Operations Desk
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Generate ONE high fidelity desktop dashboard screenshot concept for Balancebook, a private personal account ledger. Wide landscape 16:10 or 16:9, front-on pixel crisp interface, no monitor/device/frame/perspective, no collage. This is a review mockup, not implemented software.
User wants COMMAND CENTER feel: compact, intentional, clear numerical hierarchy, operational overview, calm professional control. Usable normal software, not sci-fi HUD.
Functional invariants: dashboard selected; navigation Dashboard, Transactions, prominent + Add Transaction action, Scheduled, Reports; top-right profile/menu for settings; compact Synced indicator. No greeting. Clearly visible "SAMPLE DATA · DESIGN CONCEPT" label and concept number/title.
Top summary includes exactly four primary metrics: Available Funds +$12,450.00 with smaller Projected Available +$13,450.00 and target "After paycheck · Sep 11"; Income +$5,000.00 "Month to date"; Spent -$2,180.00 "Month to date"; Total Debt -$24,850.00. These are illustrative sample values.
Separate account sections Budget Accounts (3) and Debt Accounts (5). Every account visible, modest account type icons, CURRENT and smaller PROJECTED balance with shared target label. Budget rows: Everyday Checking current +$3,450.00 projected +$4,450.00; Reserve Savings current +$8,800.00 projected +$8,800.00; Cash Wallet current +$200.00 projected +$200.00. Debt rows: Everyday Visa current -$1,250.00 projected -$1,100.00; Rewards Mastercard current -$2,600.00 projected -$2,600.00; Store Card current -$500.00 projected -$500.00; Auto Loan current -$14,500.00 projected -$14,150.00; Personal Loan current -$6,000.00 projected -$6,000.00.
Compact upcoming panel four rows in date order: Rent Sep 07 -$900.00; Auto payment Sep 09 -$450.00; Visa payment Sep 10 -$150.00; Paycheck Sep 11 +$2,500.00. Link "View scheduled". If a forecast sequence is used, funds run +$12,450 -> +$11,550 -> +$11,100 -> +$10,950 -> +$13,450; no invented trend or percentages.
No category budgets, limits, savings goals, investment widgets, safe-to-spend advice, net worth dashboard card, spending donuts, fake analytics, bank connected indicators, notifications clutter, personal greeting, big decorative chart. Focus on accounts, balances, upcoming. All eight accounts and summary comfortably within screenshot. Readable real text, consistent alignment, legible high contrast muted labels, signed USD values, tasteful restrained accents.
Concept label: "01 / Operations Desk".
Specific composition and art direction: Dark graphite command desk. Narrow left sidebar with icon and text navigation. Four compact summary cards across top. Main area below uses wide left account column with Budget Accounts above Debt Accounts and narrower right Upcoming panel. Thin dividers, small rounded corners, restrained teal accent for selection and positive amounts, soft rose negative amounts, exceptionally organized tabular numeric columns. Refined dense desktop instrument panel.
